title: SEEK Job Scraper input
description: Use this actor to search public SEEK Australia and New Zealand job listings for recruiting, job-market research, and structured AI-agent workflows.

keywords.title: Job keywords
keywords.description: Use this when you want the actor to build a SEEK search from a role or skill query. Enter ordinary search text such as software engineer or data analyst. It defaults to software engineer and can be combined with Location. Do not use this for a job URL or Boolean syntax that SEEK itself does not support.

location.title: Location
location.description: Use this to narrow a keyword search to a SEEK place name. Enter a location such as Melbourne VIC or Auckland. It is optional and defaults to an Australia-wide or New Zealand-wide search when blank. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

country.title: SEEK market
country.description: Use this to choose the public SEEK site searched by structured keywords. Choose AU for seek.com.au or NZ for seek.co.nz. It defaults to AU. This does not override the host of a supplied direct SEEK search URL.

searchUrls.title: Direct SEEK search URLs
searchUrls.description: Use this when you already configured filters on a public SEEK results page. Enter one URL per line, such as https://www.seek.com.au/jobs?keywords=data+analyst. It is optional; when present it takes precedence over Job keywords and Location. Do not enter individual job pages, login pages, or URLs from other job boards.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: Use this to choose how a keyword-built SEEK search is ordered. Choose relevance or date, for example date. It defaults to relevance. This setting does not rewrite the filters or sort order embedded in a Direct SEEK search URL.

maxResults.title: Maximum jobs
maxResults.description: Use this to cap the number of validated job records written to the dataset. Enter an integer such as 25. It defaults to 25 and accepts 1 through 200. This is not a page count; the actor stops before writing or charging more job rows than this limit.

includeDetails.title: Include job descriptions
includeDetails.description: VibeLeads scope: keep optional contact/detail extraction explicitly disabled during company discovery. A relevant stage for named qualified businesses requires verified actual build controls, source/use rights and suppression under the contact-use gate. Decline inseparable audience collection.
includeDetails.x-vibeleads-discovery: explicitly disabled; verify actual build, otherwise decline route

proxyCountry.title: Restricted access control
proxyCountry.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
